# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_prefixes (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_network_service_config_prefixes` data source to get BGP prefixes learned on a network service config



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_service_config_id` (String) Network service config ID

### Optional

- `mode` (String) Query mode (gnmi or netconf) Defaults to `gnmi`.
- `prefixes` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--prefixes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes`

Optional:

- `as_path` (String) AS path
- `flags` (List of String) BGP prefix flags (e.g., used, valid, best, igp)
- `igp_cost` (String) IGP cost
- `label` (String) MPLS label
- `last_queried_at` (String) Timestamp when prefixes were last queried
- `local_pref` (Number) Local preference
- `med` (Number) Multi-Exit Discriminator (MED)
- `network` (String) Network prefix in CIDR notation
- `nexthop` (String) Next hop IP address
- `path_id` (String) BGP path identifier
